review_comments_kind_fields.name: review_comments_kind_fields
review_comments_kind_fields.value:
("review_comments"."kind" = 'diff' AND "review_comments"."path" IS NOT NULL AND "review_comments"."line" IS NOT NULL AND "review_comments"."side" IS NOT NULL AND "review_comments"."url" IS NULL AND "review_comments"."selector" IS NULL AND "review_comments"."screenshot_blob_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("review_comments"."kind" = 'preview' AND "review_comments"."url" IS NOT NULL AND "review_comments"."path" IS NULL AND "review_comments"."line" IS NULL AND "review_comments"."side" IS NULL)

notification_preferences_quiet_hours_com.name: notification_preferences_quiet_hours_complete
notification_preferences_quiet_hours_com.value:
("notification_preferences"."quiet_hours_start_minute" IS NULL) = ("notification_preferences"."quiet_hours_end_minute" IS NULL)
        AND ("notification_preferences"."quiet_hours_start_minute" IS NULL OR "notification_preferences"."time_zone" IS NOT NULL)

notification_preferences_quiet_hours_ran.name: notification_preferences_quiet_hours_range
notification_preferences_quiet_hours_ran.value:
("notification_preferences"."quiet_hours_start_minute" IS NULL OR "notification_preferences"."quiet_hours_start_minute" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439)
        AND ("notification_preferences"."quiet_hours_end_minute" IS NULL OR "notification_preferences"."quiet_hours_end_minute" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439)

runs_child_has_delegation_mode.name: runs_child_has_delegation_mode
runs_child_has_delegation_mode.value: "runs"."parent_run_id" IS NULL OR "runs"."delegation_mode" IS NOT NULL
